note: Synaptic partner-type tallies, sampled up to 40 cells per source type (fewer for rare types). by_synapse_count sums individual synapses; by_distinct_partner_cells counts unique partner cells once each regardless of how many synapses they share with the sampled cells. synapse_io (added 2026-08-02) gives per-type input/output synapse totals AND per-sampled-cell averages for the same sample -- the average is the fairer cross-type comparison, since different cell types have very different sample sizes here.
